title: ExamSathi UPSC Civil Services Practice Bank
sourceLabel: ExamSathi original UPSC introductory and shared general aptitude/awareness foundation practice; not official PYQs
notes: This dedicated bank contains 10 UPSC Civil Services introductory questions plus 90 shared general aptitude and awareness foundation questions. It supports 10, 50 and 100-question practice mocks, but it is NOT a complete UPSC Civil Services Prelims syllabus bank: specialist GS coverage, CSAT Paper II, current affairs and expert review remain necessary. Questions are authored practice, not official previous-year questions.

questions.hi: भारतीय संविधान का अनुच्छेद 32 किससे संबंधित है?
questions.en: Article 32 of the Indian Constitution relates to which of the following?
optionsHi: संवैधानिक उपचार का अधिकार / Right to Constitutional Remedies
समानता का अधिकार / Right to Equality
राज्यपाल की नियुक्ति / Appointment of Governor
optionsEn: संवैधानिक उपचार का अधिकार / Right to Constitutional Remedies
समानता का अधिकार / Right to Equality
राज्यपाल की नियुक्ति / Appointment of Governor
questions.whyHi: अनुच्छेद 32 मौलिक अधिकारों के प्रवर्तन हेतु सर्वोच्च न्यायालय जाने का अधिकार देता है। / Article 32 provides the right to approach the Supreme Court for enforcement of Fundamental Rights.
questions.whyEn: अनुच्छेद 32 मौलिक अधिकारों के प्रवर्तन हेतु सर्वोच्च न्यायालय जाने का अधिकार देता है। / Article 32 provides the right to approach the Supreme Court for enforcement of Fundamental Rights.
